name: Spiritual Leaders
overview: Scripture reveals that spiritual leaders are to serve with humility and integrity, exemplified by Jesus being led by the Spirit and resisting temptation (Matthew 4:1). True leadership involves guiding others faithfully in doctrine and prayer (Acts 2:42) while living consistently, avoiding hypocrisy (Matthew 23:3). Leaders are called to shepherd their people with care and accountability, as they watch over souls with joy rather than grief (Hebrews 13:17), and must embody servant leadership, considering themselves as those who serve rather than seek status (Luke 22:26). The unchanging nature of God (Malachi 3:6) undergirds the steadfastness expected in spiritual leadership.
